LinearIssueUpdated.description:
An entry of a Linear issue's history that edits its title, description, labels, assignee or
priority, or moves it to another team, for an issue a task owns or subscribes to. It never
names a trigger.

actor.description: The Linear display name of who edited it.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

changed.description:
The fields the entry changed, of `title`, `description`, `labels`, `assignee` and
`priority`, or `identifier` alone when it moved the issue to another team.

description.description:
The first 200 characters of the issue's description when the entry changed it, as the
intake read it, not as the entry left it: Linear records no description text in history.
Null otherwise.

linear_id.description:
Linear's id of what the event is about: the issue, history entry or comment. A webhook's
state change has no history entry, so it holds the issue's id.

previous_issue.description:
The identifier the issue had before it moved to another team, which a task watched it by,
when `changed` is `identifier`; absent otherwise.

project.description: The issue's project name; null without one.

project_id.description: Linear's id of the issue's project; null without one.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

url.description: The issue's page, or the comment's for a comment.

description:
An entry of a Linear issue's history that edits its title, description, labels, assignee or
priority, or moves it to another team, for an issue a task owns or subscribes to. It never
names a trigger.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: linear.issue.updated
